description: A compatibility-preserving diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained recommender and supplies an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions. It supports architecture changes while retaining the four-dataset RecHarness evaluation protocol.
motivation: Guide model improvements using observable training behavior and public interaction data, while preventing unsupported claims about reviews, ratings, or latent user traits.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Return metrics and metric_definitions. Inspect view.model as the actual trained module; adapt embedding, sequence-feature, and scoring probes to its architecture. Consume batches shaped (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors B × L. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; mark unavailable signals as unobserved. Preserve dataset routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and macro validation HR@10 for selection. Give five real training users per category full-catalog recommendations excluding seen items. Keep DATA_DIR sourced from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and artifacts within the trial directory. Architecture changes must update the predictor writer.
pseudocode:
DiagnosisProbe(view, device): retain model and compatibility interfaces
run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
  preserve model training state; enter evaluation mode
  measure applicable probes without gradients using valid, nonpadding positions
  aggregate measured values with explicit definitions and support counts
  restore model training state
  return {metrics, metric_definitions}
diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
  include measured metrics and their definitions
  request evidence-based interpretation and distinguish observations from hypotheses
  explicitly identify unavailable signals

originality.positive: Combines architecture-aware diagnostics with explicit observability constraints and a stable benchmark interface.
originality.negative: The supplied description specifies an integration contract rather than a new diagnostic algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Could support repeatable diagnosis-driven model iteration across architectures and datasets.
future_potential.negative: Its usefulness depends on the chosen probes and whether their recommendations improve validation HR@10; no results are provided.

code_difficulty.positive: Existing compatibility interfaces and a fixed batch format provide clear implementation boundaries.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture-specific probes, correct padding treatment, aggregation, and predictor synchronization require careful implementation. Higher scores indicate greater difficulty.
